name: Spectral Graph Sparsification
shortfall_explanation: dyGRASS incremental and decremental variants require an initial sparsifier. No third licensed GPU source-and-paper pair was verified; GraphSlim sparsification uses CPU NetworKit.
limitation_notes: A matching input variant can qualify without supporting every optional mode. Missing canonical adapters and absent runtime validation remain separate from research collection eligibility.

Deletion-specific algorithm in the same paper as incremental dyGRASS. Use the dynamic-update mode with an initial sparsifier and deletion updates; preprocessing and spectral analysis include CPU stages.
Requires the dynamic-update mode, an initial sparsifier and insertion updates. Not a standalone from-scratch static sparsifier; condition-number diagnostics are not a universal epsilon certificate.
